crossRefs.note: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

translations.web: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
translations.bsb: This is how you must prepare each one, no matter how many.
translations.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
translations.asv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
